G1500.forms: εἰκῇ (-ῆ, Rec., as in cl.), adv.
G1500.root: probably from [[w:G1502]] (through the idea of failure)

G1501.forms: εἴκοσι (never -ιν in WH, cf. Bl., §5, 3, and note), indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά

G1502.strongs: properly, to be weak, i.e. yield

G1503.forms: εἴκω (obsolete pres.), see: ἔοικα Transcriber note: This form does not occur in Abbott-Smith. It should be on p. 158..
G1503.root: apparently a primary verb (perhaps akin to [[w:G1502]] through the idea of faintness as a copy)

G1504.strongs: a likeness, i.e. (literally) statue, profile, or (figuratively) representation, resemblance
senses: an image, likeness: [[r:MAT.22.20|Mat 22:20]], [[r:MRK.12.16|Mrk 12:16]], [[r:LUK.20.24|Luk 20:24]], [[r:ROM.1.23|Rom 1:23]], [[r:1CO.15.49|1Co 15:49]], [[r:REV.13.14|Rev 13:14, 15 14:9, 11 15:2 16:2 19:20 20:4]]; opposite to σκιά, [[r:HEB.10.1|Heb 10:1]]; of man, εἰ. θεοῦ, [[r:1CO.11.7|1 Co 11:7]]; of the regenerate, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ [[r:COL.3.10|Col 3:10]] (see Lft., in l.); εἰ. τ. υἱοῦ τ. θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.8.29|Rom 8:29]], [[r:2CO.3.18|2Co 3:18]]; of Christ, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ, [[r:2CO.4.4|2Co 4:4]], [[r:COL.1.15|Col 1:15]].† SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, denoting resemblance, which may however be merely accidental. εἰ. is a derived likeness and like the head on a coin or the parental likeness in a child, implies an archetype. Cf. also εἶδος, appearance, not necessarily based on reality; σκιά, a shadowed resemblance; χαρακτήρ, the impress of a stamp; μόρφη (which see), the form as indicative of the inner being. (AS)

G1506.strongs: judged by sunlight, i.e. tested as genuine (figuratively)
senses: of abstract ideas; (with) of ethical purity: [[r:PHP.1.10|Php 1:10]], [[r:2PE.3.1|2Pe 3:1]].† SYN.: ἁγνός (which see), καθαρός, cf. Tr., Syn.: §lxxxv; DB, iv, 176a; Cremer, 378; Westc. on [[r:1JN.3.3|1Jn 3:3.]] (AS)

G1510.root: the first person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a primary and defective verb
G1510.kjv: am, have been, X it is I, was
senses: with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.

Of persons and things, to be, exist: [[r:ACT.17.28|Act 17:28]], [[r:JHN.1.1|Jhn 1:1, 8:58, 17:5]], al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), [[r:REV.1.4|Rev 1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5]] (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, [[r:ROM.4.17|Rom 4:17]], [[r:1CO.1.28|1Co 1:28]].
Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: [[r:MAT.24.3|Mat 24:3]], [[r:MRK.14.2|Mrk 14:2, 15:42]], [[r:LUK.21.23|Luk 21:23]], [[r:JHN.4.6|Jhn 4:6, 23, 5:10]], al.

there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: [[r:MAT.16.28|Mat 16:28]], [[r:LUK.16.19|Luk 16:19]], [[r:JHN.3.1|Jhn 3:1, 5:2]], [[r:ROM.3.10|Rom 3:10]], al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), [[r:MAT.16.22|Mat 16:22]], [[r:LUK.1.7|Luk 1:7]], [[r:JHN.18.10|Jhn 18.10]], [[r:ROM.9.2|Rom 9:2]], al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), [[r:MAT.16.28|Mat 16:28, 19:2]], [[r:MRK.9.1|Mrk 9:1]], al.;
with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: [[r:HEB.9.5|Heb 9:5]], [[r:1CO.11.20|1Co 11:20]], RV (but see ICC, in l.).
As copula uniting subject and predicate.
Expressing simply identity or equivalence: [[r:MAT.5.13|Mat 5:13, 14:15]], [[r:LUK.1.18|Luk 1:18, 19]], [[r:JHN.1.1|Jhn 1:1, 4:19]], [[r:REV.3.9|Rev 3:9]], al. mult.

Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: [[r:MAT.13.19|Mat 13:19]], [[r:1CO.9.2|1Co 9:2, 10:4, 11:25]], [[r:GAL.4.24|Gal 4:24]], [[r:REV.17.15|Rev 17:15]], al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, [[r:MAT.27.46|Mat 27:46]], [[r:MRK.7.2|Mrk 7:2]], [[r:ROM.7.18|Rom 7:18]] al.; ὅ ἐστιν, [[r:MRK.3.17|Mrk 3:17]], [[r:COL.1.24|Col 1:24]], [[r:HEB.7.2|Heb 7:2]], al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: [[r:MAT.26.26|Mat 26:26-28]], [[r:MRK.14.22|Mrk 14:22, 24]], [[r:LUK.22.19|Luk 22:19]], [[r:1CO.11.24|1Co 11:24]] (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.).
C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.);

with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), [[r:MAT.7.29|Mat 7:29]], [[r:MRK.1.22|Mrk 1:22]], [[r:LUK.4.31|Luk 4:31, 14:1]], [[r:ACT.1.10|Act 1:10]], al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, [[r:ROM.12.9|Rom 12:9, 10]], [[r:HEB.13.5|Heb 13:5]], al.; (with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), [[r:LUK.23.9|Luk 23:9.]]
Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): [[r:MAT.19.5|Mat 19:5]], [[r:MRK.10.8|Mrk 10:8]], [[r:HEB.8.10|Heb 8:10]], al.

of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, [[r:MAT.14.27|Mat 14:27]], [[r:MRK.6.50|Mrk 6:50]], al.; absol. (cf. [[r:DEU.32.39|Deu 32:39]]; אֲנִי הוּא), [[r:MRK.13.6|Mrk 13:6]], [[r:JHN.4.26|Jhn 4:26]], al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι). (AS)
εἴ-περ, see: εἰ. εἰ, conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
with indic, expressing a general assumption;

pres.: before indic, pres., [[r:MAT.11.14|Mat 11:14]], [[r:ROM.8.25|Rom 8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[r:MRK.4.23|Mrk 4:23 9:22]], [[r:JHN.15.18|Jhn 15:18]], [[r:1CO.7.9|1Co 7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[r:LUK.16.31|Luk 16:31]], [[r:ROM.8.11|Rom 8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[r:MAT.12.26|Mat 12:26]], [[r:ROM.4.14|Rom 4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[r:LUK.17.6|Luk 17:6]], [[r:JHN.8.39|Jhn 8:39]]; before quæst., [[r:MAT.6.23|Mat 6:23]], [[r:JHN.5.47|Jhn 5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[r:1PE.2.20|1Pe 2:20]];
Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: [[r:MAT.12.28|Mat 12:28]], [[r:JHN.7.4|Jhn 7:4]], [[r:ROM.5.17|Rom 5:17]], al.
Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[r:MRK.15.44|Mrk 15:44]], [[r:1JN.3.13|1Jn 3:13]], al.

C. indic., as in LXX ([[r:NUM.14.3|Num 14:3]]o, [[r:1SA.14.45|1Ki 14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[r:MRK.8.12|Mrk 8:12]], [[r:HEB.3.11|Heb 3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: [[r:ACT.24.19|Act 24:19 27:39]], [[r:1CO.14.10|1Co 14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17.

As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[r:MAT.26.63|Mat 26:63]], [[r:MRK.15.36|Mrk 15:36]], [[r:ACT.19.2|Act 19:2]], [[r:2CO.13.5|2Co 13:5]], al.; fut., [[r:MRK.3.2|Mrk 3:2]], [[r:ACT.8.22|Act 8:22]], al.; aor., [[r:MRK.15.44|Mrk 15:44]], [[r:1CO.1.16|1Co 1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), [[r:PHP.3.12|Php 3:12.]]

As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, [[r:GEN.17.17|Gen 17:17]], al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: [[r:MRK.8.23|Mrk 8:23]] (Tr., WH, txt.), [[r:LUK.13.23|Luk 13:23, 22:49]], [[r:ACT.19.2|Act 19:2]], al.
εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: [[r:LUK.11.18|Luk 11:18]]; but even if, [[r:1CO.4.7|1Co 4:7]], [[r:2CO.4.3|2Co 4:3 11:16]].
εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: [[r:MRK.2.21|Mrk 2:21, 22]] [[r:JHN.14.2|Jhn 14:2]], [[r:REV.2.5|Rev 2:5]], al.

εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: [[r:MAT.24.22|Mat 24:22]], [[r:MRK.2.26|Mrk 2:26 6:5]], [[r:JHN.9.33|Jhn 9:33]], [[r:1CO.7.17|1Co 7:17]] (only), [[r:GAL.1.19|Gal 1:19]] (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), [[r:1CO.14.5|1Co 14:5 15:2]], [[r:1TI.5.19|1Ti 5:19]].
εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely ([[r:EZK.33.27|Eze 33:27]], al.): [[r:HEB.6.14|Heb 6:14]].

G1514.kjv: be at (have, live in) peace, live peaceably

G1515.root: probably from a primary verb εἴρω (to join)
G1515.strongs: peace (literally or figuratively); by implication, prosperity
G1515.kjv: one, peace, quietness, rest, + set at one again
senses: of public peace, freedom from war: [[r:LUK.14.32|Luk 14:32]], [[r:ACT.12.20|Act 12:20 24:2]]; of the church, [[r:ACT.9.31|Ac 9:31]].

Of peace between persons, concord, agreement : [[r:MAT.10.34|Mat 10:34]], [[r:LUK.12.51|Luk 12:51]], [[r:ROM.14.17|Rom 14:17]], [[r:1CO.7.15|1Co 7:15]], [[r:GAL.5.22|Gal 5:22]], [[r:JAS.3.18|Jas 3:18]]; ζητεῖν εἰ., [[r:1PE.3.11|1Pe 3:11]]; διώκειν, [[r:2TI.2.22|2Ti 2:22]]; ib. before μετὰ πάντων, [[r:HEB.12.14|Heb 12:14]]; by meton., of him who brings peace, [[r:EPH.2.14|Eph 2:14.]]

As in LXX (= Heb. שָׁלוֹם, Aram. שְׁלָם), of a state of security and safety: [[r:JHN.16.33|Jhn 16:33]], [[r:ROM.2.10|Rom 2:10]], [[r:1TH.5.3|1Th 5:3]],́ whence the formulae, ὕπαγε (πορεύου) εἰς εἰ, [[r:MRK.5.34|Mrk 5:34]], [[r:LUK.7.50|Luk 7:50]] (cf. [[r:1SA.1.17|1Ki 1:17]], al.; לְכִי לְשָׁלוֹם); εἰ. ὑμῖν (שָׁלוֹם לָכֶם), [[r:JHN.20.19|Jhn 20:19, 21, 26]]; ἀπολύειν ἐν εἰ., [[r:LUK.2.29|Luk 2:29]], cf. [[r:1CO.16.11|1Co 16:11]]; ἡ εἰ. ὑμῶν, [[r:MAT.10.13|Mat 10:13]], [[r:LUK.10.6|Luk 10:6]]; υἱὸς εἰρήνης, ib.

Of spiritual peace, the peace of Christ's kingdom (DCG, ii, 330f.): [[r:LUK.1.79|Luk 1:79 2:14]] [[r:JHN.16.33|Jhn 16:33]], [[r:ROM.2.10|Rom 2:10 5:1 8:6]], al.; ὁ κύριος τῆς εἰ., [[r:2TH.3.16|2Th 3:16]]; ὁ θεὸς τῆς εἰ., [[r:ROM.15.33|Rom 15:33 16:20]], [[r:2CO.13.11|2Co 13:11]], al.; in epistolary salutations, [[r:ROM.1.7|Rom 1:7]], [[r:1CO.1.3|1Co 1:3]], [[r:GAL.1.3|Gal 1:3]], [[r:1TH.1.1|1Th 1:1]], [[r:1PE.1.2|1Pe 1:2]], 2Jo 3, [[r:REV.1.4|Rev 1:4]], al. (see Cremer, 244). (AS)

G1517.strongs: to be a peace-maker, i.e. (figuratively) to harmonize

G1519.strongs: to or into (indicating the point reached or entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.); also in adverbial phrases
G1519.kjv: (abundant-)ly, against, among, as, at, (back-)ward, before, by, concerning, + continual, + far more exceeding, for (intent, purpose), fore, + forth, in (among, at, unto, -so much that, -to), to the intent that, + of one mind, + never, of, (up-)on, + perish, + set at one again, (so) that, therefore(-unto), throughout, til, to (be, the end, -ward), (here-)until(-to), …ward, (where-)fore, with
senses: prep. with accusative, expressing entrance, direction, limit, into, unto, to, upon, towards, for, among (Lat. in, with accusative).

of approach, to or towards: [[r:MRK.11.1|Mrk 11:1]], [[r:LUK.6.8|Luk 6:8, 19:28]], [[r:JHN.11.31|Jhn 11:31, 21:6]], al.; (with) before pl. and collective nouns, among: [[r:MRK.4.7|Mrk 4:7, 8:19, 20]], [[r:LUK.11.49|Luk 11:49]], [[r:JHN.21.23|Jhn 21:23]], al.;

Of a limit reached, unto, on, upon: [[r:MAT.8.18|Mat 8:18, 21:1]], [[r:MRK.11.1|Mrk 11:1, 13:16]], [[r:LUK.14.10|Luk 14:10]], [[r:JHN.6.3|Jhn 6:3, 11:32]], al.; with accusative of person(s) (as in Ep. and Ion.), [[r:ACT.23.15|Act 23:15]], [[r:ROM.5.12|Rom 5:12, 16:19]], [[r:2CO.10.14|2Co 10:14]];

elliptical: ἐπιστολαὶ εἰς Δαμασκόν, [[r:ACT.9.2|Act 9:2]]; ἡ διακονία μου ἡ εἰς Ἱ., [[r:ROM.15.31|Rom 15:31]]; metaphorically, of entrance into a certain state or condition, or of approach or direction towards some end (Thayer, B, i, 1; ii, 1), εἰς τ. ὄνομα, M, Pr., 200.

after verbs of seeing: [[r:MAT.6.26|Mat 6:26]], [[r:MRK.6.41|Mrk 6:41]], [[r:LUK.9.16|Luk 9:16, 62]], [[r:JHN.13.22|Jhn 13:22]], al.; metaphorically, of the mind, [[r:HEB.11.26|Heb 11:26, 12:2]], al.;

in "pregnant" construction, implying previous motion (cl.; see WM, 516; Bl., §39, 3; M, Pr., 234f.): [[r:MAT.2.23|Mat 2:23, 4:13]], [[r:2TH.2.4|2Th 2:4]], [[r:2TI.1.11|2Ti 1:11]], [[r:HEB.11.9|Heb 11:9]], al.;
by an assimilation general in late Gk (see Bl., M, Pr., ll. with) = ἐν: [[r:LUK.1.44|Luk 1:44, 4:23]], [[r:ACT.20.16|Act 20:16, 21:17]], [[r:JHN.1.18|Jhn 1:18]] (but see Westc, in l.), al.
accentuating the duration expressed by the accusative: εἰς τ. αἰῶνα, [[r:MAT.21.19|Mat 21:19]]; εἰς γενεὰς καὶ γ., [[r:LUK.1.50|Luk 1:50]]; εἰς τ. διηνεκές, [[r:HEB.7.3|Heb 7:3]], al.

Of a point or limit of time, unto, up to, until: [[r:MAT.6.34|Mat 6:34]], [[r:ACT.4.3|Act 4:3, 25:21]], [[r:PHP.1.10|Php 1:10, 2:16]], [[r:1TH.4.15|1Th 4:15]], [[r:2TI.1.12|2Ti 1:12]]; of entrance into a future period, σεις τὸ μέλλον (see: μέλλω), next (year), [[r:LUK.13.9|Luk 13:9]] (but with ICC, in l.); εἰς τ. μεταξὺ σάββατον, on the next Sabbath, [[r:ACT.13.42|Act 13:42]]; εἰς τὸ πάλιν (see: πάλιν, [[r:2CO.13.2|2Co 13:2.]]

Of result, after verbs of changing, joining, dividing, etc.: στρέφειν εἰς, [[r:REV.11.6|Rev 11:6]]; μετας-, [[r:ACT.2.20|Act 2:20]], [[r:JAS.4.9|Jas 4:9]]; μεταλλάσσειν, [[r:ROM.1.26|Rom 1:26]]; σχίζειν εἰς δύο, [[r:MAT.27.51|Mat 27:51]], al.; predicatively with εἴναι, [[r:ACT.8.23|Act 8:23.]]

Of relation, to, towards, for, in regard to (so in cl., but more frequently in late Gk., εἰς encroaching on the simple dative, which it has wholly displaced in MGr.; Jannaris, Gr., §1541; Robertson, Gr., 594; Deiss., BS, 117f.): [[r:LUK.7.30|Luk 7:30]], [[r:ROM.4.20|Rom 4:20, 15:2, 26]], [[r:1CO.16.1|1Co 16:1]], [[r:EPH.3.16|Eph 3:16]], al.; ἀγάπη εἰς, [[r:ROM.5.8|Rom 5:8]], al.; χρηστός, [[r:EPH.4.32|Eph 4:32]]; φρονεῖν εἰς, [[r:ROM.12.16|Rom 12:16]]; θαρρεῖν, [[r:2CO.10.1|2Co 10:1.]]

Of the end or object: εὔθετος εἰς, [[r:LUK.14.34|Luk 14:34]]; σόφος, [[r:ROM.16.19|Rom 16:19]]; ἰσχύειν, [[r:MAT.5.13|Mat 5:13]]; εἰς τοῦτο, [[r:MRK.1.38|Mrk 1:38]], al.; ἀφορίζειν εἰς, [[r:ROM.1.1|Rom 1:1]]; indicating purpose, εἰς φόβον, [[r:ROM.8.15|Rom 8:15]]; εἰς ἔνδειξιν, [[r:ROM.3.25|Rom 3:25]]; εἰς τό, with inf. (= ἵνα or ὥστε; Bl., §71, 5; M, Pr., 218ff.): [[r:MAT.20.19|Mat 20:19]], [[r:ROM.1.11|Rom 1:11]], [[r:1CO.9.18|1Co 9:18]], al.
Adverbial phrases: εἰς τέλος, εἰς τὸ πάλιν, etc (see: τέλος, πάλιν, etc.). (AS)

G1520.kjv: a(-n, -ny, certain), + abundantly, man, one (another), only, other, some
senses: εἷς ιά, ἕν, genitive ἑνός, μιᾶς, ἑνός, cardinal numeral, one;

one, as opposite to many: [[r:MAT.25.15|Mat 25:15]], [[r:ROM.5.12|Rom 5:12]], [[r:1CO.10.8|1Co 10:8]], al.; as subst., [[r:ROM.5.15|Rom 5:15]], [[r:EPH.2.14|Eph 2:14]]; id. with genitive partit., [[r:MAT.5.19|Mat 5:19]], al.; before ἐκ (ἐξ), [[r:MRK.14.18|Mrk 14:18]], [[r:JHN.6.8|Jhn 6:8]], al.; metaphorically, of union and concord, [[r:JHN.10.30|Jhn 10:30 17:11]], [[r:ROM.12.4|Rom 12:4-5]], [[r:PHP.1.27|Php 1:27]]; ἀπὸ μιᾶς (B1., § 44, 1), [[r:LUK.14.18|Luk 14:18]]; with neg., εἷς... οὐ (μή), more emphatic than οὐδείς, no one, none (cl.), [[r:MAT.5.18|Mat 5:18 10:29]], [[r:LUK.11.46|Luk 11:46 12:6]].
Emphatically, to the exclusion of others;

In late Gk., with weakened force, = τις or indef. art. (of. Heb. אֶחָד, [[r:GEN.22.13|Gen 22:13]], al.; see B1., § 45, 2; M, Pr., 96 f.): [[r:MAT.8.19|Mat 8:19 19:6]], [[r:REV.8.13|Rev 8:13]], al.; εἷς τις (Bl., l.with), [[r:LUK.22.50|Luk 22:50]], [[r:JHN.11.49|Jhn 11:49]]

Distributively: εἷς καστος (cl.), [[r:LUK.4.40|Luk 4:40]], [[r:ACT.2.6|Act 2:6]], al.; εἷς... καὶ εἷς (cl., εἷς μὲν... εἷς δέ), [[r:MAT.17.4|Mat 17:4]], [[r:MRK.9.5|Mrk 9:5]], [[r:JHN.20.12|Jhn 20:12]], al. (cf. LXX and use of Heb. אֶחָד, [[r:EXO.17.12|Exo 17:12]], al); ὁ εἷς... ὁ ἕτερος (ἄλλος) = cl. ὁ μὲν (ἕτερος)... ὁ δέ (ἕτερος), [[r:MAT.6.24|Mat 6:24]], [[r:LUK.7.41|Luk 7:41]], [[r:REV.17.10|Rev 17:10]]; καθ᾽ εἷς, εἷς κ. είς (in which καθ᾽ is adverbial, or the expression formed from the analogy of ἕν καθ᾽ ἔν; M, Pr., 105), one by one, severally: [[r:MRK.14.19|Mrk 14:19]], [[r:ROM.12.5|Rom 12:5]], al.; εἷς τὸν ἕνα = ἀλλήλους (B1., 45, 2; M, Pr., 246), [[r:1TH.5.11|1Th 5:11.]]
As ordinal = πρῶτος (like Heb. אֶחָד; Bl., § 45, 1; M, Pr., 95 f.), first: [[r:MAT.28.1|Mat 28:1]], [[r:MRK.16.2|Mrk 16:2]], al (AS)

G1521.kjv: bring in(-to), (+ was to) lead into

senses: to listen, assent to; pass., to be heard: of persons praying, [[r:MAT.6.7|Mat 6:7]], [[r:HEB.5.7|Heb 5:7]]; of the prayer offered, [[r:LUK.1.13|Luk 1:13]], [[r:ACT.10.31|Act 10:31]] (cf. [[r:PSA.4.2|Psa 4:2]], [[r:SIR.34.26|Sir 34:26]]); see Cremer, 624).† (AS)

G1525.kjv: X arise, come (in, into), enter in(-to), go in (through)
